title: "Claude models unavailable — you're not signed in", when you are

steps.path: Click the model name at the bottom of the window, then search
steps.headline: Every Claude model was greyed out and told you to sign in, on a machine that was signed in.
steps.changed: The menu judged your sign-in from the setup wizard's notes, which come back blank after the first launch. It now asks Claude Code itself.
steps.measured: 4 of 4 Claude models greyed before, 0 after
steps.notice: Haiku, Sonnet, Opus and Fable are pickable again, and the "no model providers" line is gone.
steps.risk: The new check costs about a tenth of a second, at most once a minute.

steps.path: The Claude Code card, directly above the ChatGPT one
steps.headline: Claude Code now names your account and plan, the way the ChatGPT card below it does.
steps.changed: The card said "Not set up yet" — the same wrong source. It now names your account and plan.
steps.notice: The two cards read as one system. My Account and Sign out appear on the Claude card too.
steps.risk: Your email is now on screen in Settings. The ChatGPT card already showed it, but it is one more thing a screen-share reveals.

steps.path: What the app says when it genuinely cannot tell
steps.headline: When the check can't answer, the app says so instead of inventing "signed out".
steps.changed: Four answers now, not two: signed in, signed out, not installed, couldn't tell. Only the middle two grey a model out.
steps.notice: Sign out in a terminal and the app notices within a minute. Before, it claimed you were signed in forever.
steps.risk: "Couldn't tell" leaves models switched on, so a real breakage shows when a message fails, not in the menu. Say if you'd rather it erred the other way.
